texts.text: If you have any questions or need support, please contact an administrator!
A password reset link will be sent to your email address. If you don't receive an email within a few minutes, please try again.
Please enter a valid e-mail address
A password reset link has been sent to your email address. This can take a few minutes. Please check your email.
The password must contain at least one digit.
The password must contain at least one lowercase letter.
The password must contain at least one special character.
The password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
The password must be at least 6 characters long.
These are your Terms and Conditions.
Enter the name of the product
Enter or select the developer of the product
Click on "Confirm" if you want to close the window without saving your last entries. If you want to save the details, click on "Cancel" to return to the product design.

If you click on "Submit product", the draft will be forwarded to the responsible administrator. After that, you will no longer be able to edit the details of the product. Do you really want to submit the product?
Please enter all required product data and submit the product for examination by me (admin).

Enter the product name and the product size of the product standard here. Make sure to enter a meaningful product name if there are different variants of this product (different products due to different value chains).
Please enter all product information and then release the product to me for review. (admin)
Material groups involved in the product standard

Add the material groups used in the product standard (min. one material group). Please also indicate the specification and the final condition of the respective material group in the production process. Also note that the selection of the material group(s) has an impact on the product variants.
Final state of the raw material group in the production process
Final state of the raw material group
Please add all product details and then release the product for review. (Admin)

In which alternative variants should the product be offered? Add the deviations via the plus button in the corresponding categories. Please note that certified materials must be specified as individual variants under "Alternative materials".
Order of the specified product variants

Please arrange the previously specified product variants, starting with the minimum (1) and ending with the maximum, in order of material requirements. The product standard is highlighted in dark green. This sorting is important in order to be able to calculate the effort and material costs for the respective product specification later on.
Upload all files for the product

Please describe the product in a short text to support the manufacturing process and add a gallery image. Also upload the necessary files for the production of the product. Please note that the uploaded file names and the selected categorisations will also be made available to the producers accordingly.
Describe the product for the producers
Size in the product standard (H, W, D)

The selected producers have been suggested to be requested for the product. They can be manually adjusted and requested as soon as a processing deadline has been set. Producers who have already been requested cannot be deselected or requested again.
A processing deadline for entering the production processes can be specified here, which is valid for all selected producers.
Are you sure you want to request the selected producers for the product? The producers are then activated to enter their work steps into the product's production chain within the processing deadline.
The work steps already entered by producers are listed here. You can also reset the steps at this point, but please note that this may affect the value chains!
Here, all options calculated for the production of the product are listed. Additionally, the average rating for each calculated option is provided.
The product is currently with the developer. You can view information that has already been entered in the product details. If you have any further questions, please contact the developer directly.
The processing deadline for this product expires on {0}.
The value chain planning is completed, you cannot make any changes at the moment. If there is a need to make adjustments to the planning, please contact the admin.

Wenn du an der Bearbeitung des unten aufgeführten Produkts teilnehmen möchtest, klicke bitte auf „Planungsanfrage annehmen“ und trage anschließend in der folgenden Ansicht deine Produktionsschritte in die Wertkette ein. Wenn du nicht an der Planung des Produkts teilnehmen möchtest, klicke bitte auf „Planungsanfrage ablehnen

Please create a possible value chain as the basis for the first producer. When hovering over the lines, buttons are displayed to add new states or edit states that have already been created. You can edit the states already specified in the value chain in the product details. As soon as producers have registered, you can no longer add states. Various options can then be calculated for the value chains.

Please enter your work steps in the value chain planning. Possible start states are displayed when hovering over the states, possible result states are displayed as soon as you have selected a start state. You can also add your own states by hovering over the lines between the existing states and clicking on the plus sign. If you have already entered states, you can edit them using the editing pencil.
Final state of the raw material group in value chain planning
This step has not yet been registered by any producer
This step has already been registered by a producer
This step has been registered by you
Please enter the new state here. Note that the pop-up will automatically close after the timer expires, without saving your entries.
Another state is currently being added at this position by another user. Please try again in a few minutes.

In the selected step, the final state of a raw material group is skipped, so you also want to take care of the final assembly of the product. If this is the case, please click “Continue Editing”. If you would be willing to only adopt partial steps from the process you have chosen, please enter these separately. You can do this right now by clicking on “Cancel” and selecting the sub-steps, or you can first “Continue editing” here and add additional sub-steps after completing the currently selected step.

Your details from the product standard are automatically transferred here. If there are any changes for this product specification, please enter them accordingly. For the cost details, it is sufficient to enter a new entry for the standard material; other material variants will then be adjusted on a percentage basis.
Click on "Confirm" if you want to close the window without saving your last entries. If you want to save the details, click on "Cancel" to return to the work step.
If you click on "Submit work step", the corresponding work step is entered in the value chain planning.
Please indicate how many hours you need to complete this step, taking into account your current order situation. Also state the time frame in which you can complete this step.
Estimated order processing time in weeks
Deliveries of products from other trades are required at the latest after

Add the material costs. If you are unable to produce a variant, activate the corresponding checkbox (this option is only available for product variants). Also enter a flat rate for transportation and assembly to take into account the costs for transportation within Hamburg or assembly.
Costs for additional materials (e.g. fittings, foils, ....)
Are you sure you want to delete this work step?
Estimated order processing time in weeks
Please enter the maximum cost for this product.
The product has been transferred to the shop. Please go to the shop and check the product. You can then publish the product via the shop.
Are you sure you want to delete this product? This action cannot be undone.
This product has already been published to the shop and cannot be deleted.
Are you sure you want to make changes to the already published product? A copy will be created for editing, which must be published again to transfer the changes to the shop.
Are you sure you want to republish the product? The product will be updated at the next possible time with the next import.
In the table below, you can view the different steps and the current status of the requested value chain.
If you can accept the order for the listed work step, please confirm the request. If you are unable to process the order at this time, please click "Reject Order".
My Earnings for the Work Step
My Calculation for the Work Step
By accepting the order, you confirm that you can complete it within the estimated processing time you have specified. The order will then be marked as accepted and can only be reset by the admin.

In the following table, you can see the various work steps and the current status of the commissioned value chain. When you start or complete a work step, you can indicate this by activating the buttons. If you have multiple work steps, multiple activations of the buttons are possible. Your work steps are highlighted.
When you start processing, we will mark this accordingly in the system. Please remember to click the "Finish Processing" button as soon as you have completed your work step.
When you finish processing, we will mark this accordingly in the system. If you are responsible for multiple work steps in the value chain, the "Start Processing" button will be activated again.

When you complete an order, you confirm that the product has successfully reached the end customer and has been installed if necessary. Please add the corresponding delivery confirmation. Once you have confirmed this step, it cannot be undone.
You can add a note here. The note is not visible to the developer.
The developer's information can be adjusted at any time.
The producer still has active orders and cannot be deleted.
You can add a note here. The note is not visible to the producer.
If you confirm the action, the {0} will be deleted from the system.
This developer is associated with a product. To delete them, the product must be deleted first.
This producer is associated with a product. To delete them, the product must be deleted first.
Are you sure you want to switch to the selected user's view? Doing so will exit your administration view.
By deleting, the {0} must be removed from all affected products.
Are you sure you want to delete the {0}'s profile? This action cannot be undone.
To invite a developer to the platform, the fields marked with * are mandatory. No account can be created without entering this information.

To invite a producer to the platform, the fields marked with * are mandatory. No account can be created without this information. You can enter the value chain parameters after the producer has registered.
If you enter a pseudonym, it will be displayed for you in the shop. The pseudonym cannot be edited afterwards.
This email was sent to reset your password and assign a new one
Click the button to reset your password
You have been invited to register on the Production Next Door platform. Click on the button to start the registration process:
A new product has been released for processing
The new product “{0}” has been released to you for editing. Please enter all the information necessary to produce the product there. You can then submit the product to us.
Planning request for a new product

There is a new planning request for the product “{0}”. Please click on the “View product” button and give us feedback as to whether you can take part in the planning. You can then enter your work steps for the product up to {1}.
Extension of Processing Deadline for Product"{0}"
Click the button to go directly to the product:
The product with id = {0} could not be deleted. Please try again.
This product has already been published to the shop and cannot be deleted.
The product with id = {0} is not ready for developer
The product with id = {0} can't be edited
You must select an active developer for a product
Current user is not assigned to the product
Not all general information is filled
There should be at least one material group set
1 to 2 specifications must be selected per work piece.
'{0}' is used several times as the final state. However, it must be unique.
The processing deadline is not valid
State is locked by other user or not locked
State currently locked by other user
New state added to the production branch. Adjust accordingly to the new data.
No new state can be added at this place
Can't edit the product anymore.The processing deadline passed
Can't export product that is not yet ready for production
You have to choose tradeType from the list
Only users that didn't complete the registration can be removed
Developer cannot be deleted because they still have assigned products

A new production request has been made for the product "{0}". Please accept or decline the request within the next 3 working days. If we do not receive any feedback within this time, the request will automatically be considered declined. Click the "View Production Request" button to go directly to the request.

Hi {0},
You recently accepted the production enquiry for the furniture '{1}'. Fortunately, all producers involved have confirmed the enquiry which is why the order is hereby placed.
The button below will take you to the order details. Here you will also see your planned time window for order processing, as well as information on the other producers, the product specifications and the customer.
Please include the order in your production planning according to this information.
No Value Chain came about for order {0} of product '{1}'.

No value chain came about for the order with the number {0} for product '{1}' from {2}. Please contact the producers and check manually whether the product can be manufactured after all. The requested value chains with the feedback from the producers are listed in order management. You can also use the re-request button to the left of the process steps of the value chain options. If necessary, contact the customer to apologise for any delays in delivery. The customer information can also be found in order management. If the product is still not producible, inform the customer about the cancellation of the purchase and the options for a new, later order.
No Value Chain came about for order {0} of product '{1}'.
Order {0} has been completed. You can see the delivery documents on the order details page
Are you sure you want to cancel this order?
Final state of the raw material group
Are you sure you want to delete this material?
Are you sure you want to delete this specification?
Are you sure you want to delete this group?
